findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No default or hardcoded credential remains in app/init.py. Every seeded account receives a password from generate_random_secret(), which draws 32 characters via secrets.choice over letters/digits/punctuation and re-draws until validate_password_policy accepts the result, so no credential is derivable from source. The initial Chef password is never printed or logged and the account is created with must_change_password=True, leaving it unusable until replaced through the reset flow; the account name itself comes from settings.CHEF_USERNAME, which is required from the environment rather than defaulted. The five demo staff and customer accounts also get per-run generated passwords with must_change_password=True and are created only when settings.ENVIRONMENT is not ENV.PRODUCTION. Alternative mitigation accepted: per-run CSPRNG generation plus forced rotation removes the default-credential class rather than changing one default to another | verdict=pass confidence=high
